title: Days Out by Train With Kids: Railcards and 2FOR1 Tips
description: How to do days out by train with kids: the Family & Friends Railcard, 2FOR1 attraction offers, booking ahead, off-peak tickets and keeping kids happy on board.
h1: Days out by train with kids
intro: No parking, no traffic and the journey is part of the fun. Travelling by train can also unlock 2FOR1 offers at attractions.

image.alt: A red steam locomotive on a railway line

cardText: Railcards, 2FOR1 offers and keeping kids happy on board.

blocks.title: Scout’s train tip
blocks.text: A Family & Friends Railcard can cut adult and child fares on many journeys, and your rail tickets can unlock 2FOR1 entry at attractions.
points: Book advance tickets for long journeys
Pack snacks and a card game

sections.html: The Family & Friends Railcard gives a third off adult fares and 60% off child fares on many journeys when at least one child travels. Check the railcard rules for restrictions.
With valid National Rail tickets, the Days Out Guide offers 2FOR1 or money off at hundreds of attractions. See how 2FOR1 works.

• Reserve seats together on longer journeys.
  • Bring snacks, water, headphones and a game.
  • Choose attractions close to the station, like London’s free museums.

faqs.q: How much does the Family & Friends Railcard save?
faqs.a: It typically gives a third off adult fares and 60% off child fares on eligible journeys when travelling with at least one child. Check the current terms.
